name: Okoppe (Japan)
description: A yellow field charged at the centre with the Okoppe town emblem in navy: a disc above a stylised winged base, like a human figure.
history: Municipal flag of Okoppe, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 April 1968; the emblem dates from 20 October 1923.

features.role: Okoppe town emblem — a disc above a stylised winged base, like a human figure
